description: Free dry run of launch_project (or of add_directories on a launched project) with the same arguments: how many directories it would submit to, what is missing, what would unlock more and what it costs, plus the top and median DR of the auto pick. Its would_submit count is the confirm_selected that launch_project or add_directories requires for the same arguments.

auto_replace.description: true: within a day the free allowance fills up to 100 with fitting directories, replacing declined ones too. include turns it off unless you send true

directories.description: "auto" (best matches, highest DR first), {include: [ids]} exactly these, or {exclude: [ids]} auto without these

excluded_directories.description: Replaces the project's whole exclusion list for this request; [] clears it. directories: {exclude} leaves some out once instead

name: preview_launch
title: Preview a launch
